# frozen fixture schema stub

Schema version: 2

The fixture retains legacy date-only journal entries. Readers also accept
timestamped entries with client, host, and session fields. A later note with
no create entry is a waivable error. Manual note edits can appear as
`edit` events with client `manual`.

Fenced code is excluded from the prose word budget. Keep each fenced Mermaid
diagram to 15 lines of source.
